notes:
{出版|しゅっぱん} refers to publishing or publication of books and other written materials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出版|しゅっぱん}する (to publish)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}される (to be published)
- ○○⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出版|しゅっぱん}する (to publish XX)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出版|しゅっぱん}⟦{社|しゃ}→社：04660_sha⟧ (publishing company)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}⟦{業|ぎょう}→業：noentry⟧ (publishing industry)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}⟦{物|ぶつ}→物：noentry⟧ (publication, published work)
- {出版|しゅっぱん}⟦{日|び}→日：noentry⟧ (publication date)
- ⟦{自費|じひ}→自費：noentry⟧{出版|しゅっぱん} (self-publishing)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{出版|しゅっぱん} (electronic publishing)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧: issuance, publication (broader - includes newspapers, stamps)
- ⟦{刊行|かんこう}→刊行：02788_kankou⟧: publication (more formal, literary)
